title: Take-up for Enhancement for Active Seniors Programme and Plans to Build Elderly-, Child- and Disabled-friendly Features in HDB Flats and Estates
what_it_is: Take-up for Enhancement for Active Seniors Programme and Plans to Build Elderly-, Child- and Disabled-friendly Features in HDB Flats and Estates

sections.label: EASE programme household beneficiaries
sections.summary: As of end September 2021, the EASE programme has benefited more than 242,000 households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As of end September 2021, the EASE programme has benefited more than 242,000 households.

sections.label: Community Care Apartments launch
sections.summary: HDB, MND and MOH launched Community Care Apartments, with the first Bukit Batok pilot sold in Feb 2021, and future plans are being studied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, HDB, MND and MOH have launched the Community Care Apartments (CCA), a new public housing typology that integrates senior-friendly design features with care services, and facilitates community building through social programmes and communal spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The first CCA pilot at Bukit Batok was launched for sale in Feb 2021 and we are studying plans for future CCA.

sections.label: Wheelchair lifters pilot programme
sections.summary: The wheelchair lifters pilot launched in December 2018, with about 10 households participating and 10 lifters installed, and the scheme is being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, we launched the wheelchair lifters programme in December 2018 as a pilot programme, whereby about 10 households have participated and 10 wheelchair lifters have been installed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The feedback that we have received so far has been quite positive.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The seniors found it easy to use and also it encourages the seniors to go out to the community more regularly than before.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are reviewing the scheme and we will take note of the Member's suggestion and request in our review.
